title: 第31章 小孩诡影-《开局三预言？我直播通关S级末世》
content:
第(1/3)页

    苏怀瑾看上去有点犹豫：

    “我感觉那个香炉有点问题，但是又说不上来，就是一种感觉吧。”

    靳兰玦顺着她的视线看向大槐树下，昏暗阴森的树影下方，那个香灰满满当当的香炉，就那么安静放在地上。

    “唔……”

    她捏着下巴回忆，歪头问苏怀瑾。

    “这么一说，我想起刚才那群小孩诡影，绕着大槐树转圈的时候，似乎将香炉也包围进去了的。”

    苏怀瑾露出回忆的神色。

    【有吗？】

    【香炉距离树还有两三步吧？刚才那个诡影小圈子好像没那么大】

    【没啥印象了……】

    周玉的叫声打断了靳兰玦的思考：

    “快来看这些！”

    几人聚集到屋子楼梯下的储物小隔间跟前，看到周玉拖出来一个破旧的箱子。

    里面摆满了纸扎的小娃娃，巴掌大小，纸面泛黄。

    五官和衣服都是用水彩画上去的，已经黯然褪色。

    只有娃娃黑豆一样的眼睛，殷红的小嘴，以及两坨红艳艳的腮红，还保留了醒目的颜色。

    靳兰玦垂眼对上一个女娃娃的黑豆眼，胳膊上瞬间汗毛直立。

    周玉“嘶”了一声，啧啧有声：

    “都是什么布娃娃，芭比娃娃，头一回见纸娃娃，怪渗人的。”

    谢辞看了眼杂物间地面上厚厚的灰尘，只有一条拖拽的痕迹，就是周玉拉出箱子留下的。

    他眉头微微蹙起，似乎是在思考什么想不通的问题。

    “这屋里的所有东西，不要随便碰。”

    说着，专门看了眼脚边装纸娃娃的箱子。

    周玉挠挠头，有点尴尬地“哦”了一声。

    不远处昏迷的吴毅安发出吃痛的低哼，慢悠悠醒过来。

    周玉连忙开溜，凑过去问：

    “你咋回事儿啊？突然往那群小鬼里面冲，拉都拉不住！”

    吴毅安一脸懵，似乎有点反应不过来发生了什么事。

    听到周玉这么问，迷迷糊糊说：

    “我好像听到它们在唱歌，不知道为什么就想靠近去听，不然听不清楚……”

    周玉瞪大眼睛：

    “唱歌？唱啥歌让你这么沉迷，差点跟一群小鬼贴贴了都！”

    吴毅安懵懵回忆，下意识就哼唱了两句：

Su Huaijin looked a little hesitant:

"I feel like there's something wrong with that incense burner, but I can't really explain it. It's just a feeling."

Jin Lanjue followed her gaze and looked under the big locust tree. Under the dim and gloomy shadow of the tree, the incense burner full of incense ash was placed so quietly on the ground.

"Hmm..."

She pinched her chin to recall, tilted her head and asked Su Huaijin.

"Having said that, I remembered that when the group of children's shadows were circling around the big locust tree just now, they seemed to have surrounded the incense burner."

Su Huaijin looked reminiscing.

【Is there any?】

【The incense burner is still two or three steps away from the tree, right?The small circle of ghosts just now didn’t seem that big]

【No impression left...】

Zhou Yu’s cry interrupted Jin Lanjue’s thinking:

"Come and see these!"

Several people gathered in front of the storage compartment under the stairs of the house and saw Zhou Yu dragging out a shabby box.

It is filled with small dolls made of paper, the size of a palm, and the paper surface is yellowed.

The facial features and clothes were painted with watercolors and have faded.

Only the baby's black bean-like eyes, the bright red mouth, and the two bright red cheeks still retain the eye-catching color.

Jin Lanjue lowered his eyes to meet the black bean eyes of a female doll, and the hairs on his arms instantly stood up.

Zhou Yu hissed and clicked his tongue:

"They are all rag dolls, Barbie dolls. It's the first time I see a paper doll. It's so weird."

Xie Ci glanced at the thick dust on the ground in the utility room. There was only a drag mark left by Zhou Yu when he pulled out the box.

He frowned slightly, as if he was thinking about something that he couldn't figure out.

“Don’t touch anything in this room casually.”

As he said that, he looked specifically at the box containing the paper dolls at his feet.

Zhou Yu scratched his head and said "oh" a little embarrassed.

Not far away, Wu Yian, who was unconscious, groaned in pain and slowly woke up.

Zhou Yu quickly ran away, walked over and asked:

"What's going on with you? You suddenly rushed into those little guys, and you couldn't even hold them back!"

Wu Yian looked confused, as if he couldn't understand what was going on.

Hearing Zhou Yu ask this, he said in a daze:

"I seem to hear them singing, and I don't know why I want to get closer to listen, otherwise I can't hear clearly..."

Zhou Yu’s eyes widened:

"Singing? What kind of song makes you so addicted to singing that you almost got into trouble with a bunch of brats!"

Wu Yi'an recalled in a daze, and subconsciously hummed two lines:
